description: A horizontal strip of vertical lists where selecting a node reveals its children in the next column — the macOS Finder column view, with drag/keyboard-resizable columns and an optional preview pane.

props.name: children
props.description:
The strip's tree, authored recursively: root
{@link MillerColumnsColumnPropsColumn(s)} whose branch
{@link MillerColumnsItemPropsItems} nest further Columns, plus an
optional trailing {@link MillerColumnsPreviewPanelPropsPreviewPanel}.
There is no `items` data prop — the JSX *is* the data.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Initial selection path on first render, root column first (e.g.
`["docs", "guides"]`). The component owns the path thereafter.
Forbidden in controlled mode — use `value` instead.

props.name: dir
props.description:
Reading direction. Under `"rtl"` the horizontal arrow pair is
mirrored — ArrowLeft steps *into* a branch's child column and
ArrowRight walks back out — so navigation follows the visual order.
Inherited from a `DirectionProvider` ancestor when omitted.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode — pass `value` + `onValueChange` to
control the component.
Called with the new selection path whenever the selection changes.
Required in controlled mode.

props.name: value
props.description:
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode — use `defaultValue` instead.
The controlled selection path, root column first. Must be kept in sync
by the parent via `onValueChange`.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Row and column size for the whole strip; `data-density` scales each size further.

dataAttributes.name: data-miller-columns-strip
dataAttributes.when: always — a structural hook the component's own CSS uses to find this part, and yours may too

dataAttributes.name: data-miller-columns-slot
dataAttributes.when: always — a structural hook the component's own CSS uses to find this part, and yours may too

props.name: children
props.description:
The column's {@link MillerColumnsItemPropsItems} and, optionally, a
{@link MillerColumnsResizeHandlePropsResizeHandle}. Optional: a
childless branch legitimately opens an empty column, which carries
`data-empty` for the styling layer.

dataAttributes.name: data-miller-columns-column
dataAttributes.when: always — a structural hook the component's own CSS uses to find this part, and yours may too

props.name: children
props.description:
The cell content and, for a branch item, a single nested
`<MillerColumns.Column>` (split out by `partitionItemChildren`).

props.name: value
props.description:
Stable identifier used to match this item against the selection path.
The item is selected when the path entry at its depth equals `value`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the cell as a single consumer-supplied child element (e.g. an
`<a>`) instead of the default `<div>`, merging the treeitem ARIA,
handlers, and ref onto it via the {@link Slot } pattern. Any nested
`<MillerColumns.Column>` remains a sibling of the cell element.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
When `true`, the item renders `aria-disabled` / `data-disabled` and is
skipped by roving navigation — it cannot be selected, focused, or
activated.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Forwarded to the rendered element. Defaults to `HTMLDivElement`; when
using `asChild`, specify the child's element type. Composed with the
library's internal ref.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description:
Largest width the column can be dragged or stepped to, in pixels.
Published as `aria-valuemax` when finite; left unbounded by default,
in which case the attribute is omitted.

props.name: minWidth
props.description:
Smallest width the column can be dragged or stepped to, in pixels.
Also published as `aria-valuemin`.

dataAttributes.name: data-miller-columns-resize-handle
dataAttributes.when: always — a structural hook the component's own CSS uses to find this part, and yours may too

dataAttributes.name: data-dragging
dataAttributes.when: a pointer drag is in progress

props.name: children
props.description:
The preview content for the current selection (typically driven by
{@link useMillerColumnsSelection }).

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Keep the panel mounted regardless of the selection, instead of following
Finder's rule (a preview only where a selected *leaf* would open a child
column). Use it for a persistent inspector, or to animate the panel in
and out.
